settings.performance.batchSizeHelp: The number of subscribers to pull from the database in a single iteration. Each iteration pulls subscribers from the database, sends messages to them, and then moves on to the next iteration to pull the next batch. This should ideally be higher than the maximum achievable throughput (concurrency * message_rate).
settings.performance.cacheSlowQueriesHel: Only enable this on large databases that have slowed down significantly. Caches list subscriber counts, dashboard statistics etc.
settings.performance.concurrencyHelp: Maximum concurrent worker (threads) that will attempt to send messages simultaneously.
settings.performance.maxErrThresholdHelp: The number of errors (eg: SMTP timeouts while e-mailing) a running campaign should tolerate before it is paused for manual investigation or intervention. Set to 0 to never pause.
settings.performance.messageRateHelp: Maximum number of messages to be sent out per second per worker in a second. If concurrency = 10 and message_rate = 10, then up to 10x10=100 messages may be pushed out every second. This, along with concurrency, should be tweaked to keep the net messages going out per second under the target message servers rate limits if any.

settings.performance.slidingWindowDurati: Duration of the sliding window period (m for minute, h for hour).
settings.performance.slidingWindowHelp: Limit the total number of messages that are sent out in given period. On reaching this limit, messages are be held from sending until the time window clears.

settings.general.defaultReplyToVerifiedH: This reply address is filled in by default for new campaigns from other accounts.
import.mapIntro: Choose where to save each column of your file. Each row below is one column.
import.mapEncodingRequired: This file uses the Korean Excel encoding (CP949), so it can only be imported with column matching.
import.mapHeaderHint: The first row contains an email address. Turn off “First row contains column names” if your file has no header.
import.mapRawHelp: Uploads the file exactly as it is. Use this for files whose first row is email, name, attributes. ZIP files are uploaded this way too.
import.mapKeyHelp: Attributes are extra values saved for each subscriber besides email and name (e.g. country = US, follower = 14900). A column that means a standard attribute (Region → country, Followers → follower, Company Name → company) gets that name first; other names are filled in from your column names. All can be changed. New names use lowercase letters, numbers and underscores (e.g. Customer Grade → customer_grade). Click a name field to pick a standard attribute or a name you already use (those are found in the latest 50 subscribers of each selected list, so some may be missing).
import.mapTagsHelp: Saved as separate values, split at commas
import.mapOverwrite: Overwrite user information is on. Existing attributes absent from the mapped columns will be removed. Attributes are replaced, not merged.
import.mapIssuemalformed: {count} rows with the wrong number of columns
import.mapDuplicateHelp: Rows with an empty or invalid email, or with the wrong number of columns, are left out. If an address appears more than once in the file, only its first row is imported. Addresses that are already registered follow the overwrite settings above.
import.mapPreview: Import preview · first 5 rows (and up to 3 rows with values that could not be read)
import.mapPreviewHelp: If the name is empty, one is made from the email address.
import.mapRemember: When you start importing, this browser remembers the column matching (column names, what they are saved as, and attribute names). Subscriber data is never saved.
import.mapMismatch: Sent {sent} rows; the server imported {imported}. Some rows may not have been saved even though the status is finished. Check the logs below and compare the results.
import.mapBusy: Reading and checking the file… Remove the file to cancel.
import.mapErrorquotes: Unclosed or misplaced quotes make it impossible to tell rows apart. Fix the file and select it again. Nothing is imported partially.
import.mapErrorrawEncoding: Upload original only works with files saved as valid UTF-8. Split this file into parts of 10 MB or less and use column matching.
import.mapColumnErrorrole: Choose where to save this column
import.mapColumnErrorkeyInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only
import.mapErrorinputLimit: Column matching supports files up to 10 MB. Split the file, or choose Upload original if its first row is email, name, attributes.
import.mapErrorrowLimit: Column matching supports up to 50,000 data rows. Split the file, or choose Upload original if its first row is email, name, attributes.
import.mapErroroutputLimit: The data to import exceeds 20 MB. Split the file and try again.
import.mapErrordecode: Cannot read the text in this file. Save it again from your spreadsheet as “CSV UTF-8”.
import.mapErrornul: The file contains unreadable characters. Save it as CSV again.
import.mapErrordelimiter: The CSV delimiter must be one character other than a quote or newline.
import.mapErrorheader: The first row contains invalid quotes. Check the header row.
import.mapErrormapping: Check the column matching: the email column and the attribute names.
import.mapErrorread: Cannot read the file. Select it again.
import.mapErrorworker: Cannot run the CSV check in this browser. Reload and select the file again.
import.mapValidationemailColumns: Choose one column to save as the email.
import.mapValidationnameColumns: Only one column can be saved as the name.
import.mapColumnErroremailColumns: Only one column can be the email
import.mapColumnErrornameColumns: Only one column can be the name
subscribers.columns.filterHelp: With several conditions, only subscribers matching all of them are shown. Export and select-all use the same conditions.
subscribers.columns.exportNote: The attribute columns shown in the table ({columns}) are added as columns of their own.
subscribers.columns.wideHint: The columns are wider than the screen, so the table scrolls sideways: swipe it or hold Shift while scrolling.
lists.preset.label: Subscriber table columns
lists.preset.help: The attribute columns shown on this list's subscribers page. Everyone viewing the list sees the same columns.
lists.preset.inherited: Taken over from the base list ‘{name}’. You can change it.
lists.preset.creator: Creator
subscribers.columns.presetAll: The page of all subscribers shows the default columns.
presets.title: Column presets
presets.help: Make sets of attribute columns for the subscribers page and pick one per list. Changing a preset changes the subscribers page of every list that uses it at once.
presets.readOnly: Only people who may manage all lists can make and edit presets. You can only view them here.
presets.confirmDelete: Delete the preset ‘{name}’? No list uses it.
presets.confirmDeleteLists: {num} lists change to the ‘{preset}’ preset: {lists}. Subscriber data stays as it is; only the columns shown change.
presets.nameHelp: 1–40 characters. No two presets can share a name (letter case ignored).
presets.addOwn: A name that is not in the list can be added as typed.
presets.columnsHelp: 1–{max} columns, shown after the name column in this order. Names that came in through an import can be used too.
presets.editNote: Saving changes the subscribers page of the {num} lists that use this preset at once.
presets.exists: A preset with this name already exists.
presets.tooManyColumns: A preset holds up to 8 columns.
presets.invalidColumn: A column name has 1–64 characters and no control characters.
presets.duplicateColumn: A column cannot be added twice.
presets.tooMany: Up to 50 presets can be made.
import.mapStdKind.country: saved as a two-letter country code
import.mapTwin: If this means the standard attribute {key} ({label}):
import.mapStateConverted.country: Imported · {count} values changed to country codes
import.mapStateBlanked.country: Imported · {count} values that are not a country left out
import.mapStateBlanked.integer: Imported · {count} values that are not a number left out
import.mapUnreadableHelp.country: If these are not countries (regions of one country, for example), save the column under another name.
import.mapUnreadableHelp.integer: Values such as ‘about 10K’, ‘10K+’ or ‘12.500’ are not read as numbers.
import.mapValuesHelp: Only rows that will be imported are counted. Cells that mean “no value” (‘-’, ‘N/A’, ‘none’) are taken as empty and not saved. A value that could not be read is not saved under that attribute.
import.mapStdHelpTitle: Show the {count} standard attributes and their formats
import.mapStdHelpIntro: Standard attributes have a fixed name and value format, so every import adds to the same attribute in the same form. The subscribers table columns, dynamic list conditions and the campaign personalization menu use the same attributes.
import.mapStdReads.country: United States, 미국, USA, UK, us
subscribers.standard.title: Title
lists.team.required: Choose a team for the list (or choose no team on purpose).
teams.invalidName: The team name must be 1 to 90 characters without commas or line breaks.
teams.exists: A team or a tag with this name already exists.
teams.invalidUserRole: Choose a user role that does not read all lists.
teams.superAdmin: A super admin cannot join a team.
teams.needsUserRole: Set the team's default user role first: this user would still read all lists.
teams.notEmpty: Remove the team's members and lists first.
teams.managedByTeams: This role belongs to a team. Manage it on the Teams screen.
subscribers.unblockAdminOnly: Only an administrator can take a subscriber off the blocklist.
public.unsubAllHelp: If you unsubscribe, this e-mail address will not receive e-mail from any list any more.
public.unsubbedAllInfo: You have unsubscribed successfully. This e-mail address will not receive e-mail from any list any more.
teams.title: Teams
teams.help: Lists are split by team, and team members see only their own team's lists. Creating a team sets up its list role and tag automatically.
teams.cantDelete: A team with members or lists cannot be deleted
teams.nameHelp: The name is the list tag: {tag}. Spaces become dashes.
teams.defaultUserRoleHelp: Members get this user role when you add them. A role that reads all lists (lists:*_all) cannot be chosen.
teams.applyToMembers: Give this role to the current members too ({num})
teams.newNote: Lists that already carry the tag {tag} join the team as soon as it is made.
teams.renameWarn: Renaming also changes the tag {old} to {tag} on the {num} lists that carry it. Check first if you use this tag anywhere else.
teams.membersHelp: A person can be in one team only. Choosing someone from another team moves them here.
teams.roleChangesAll: Gets the team's user role (loses the right to read all lists)
teams.membersNote: A super admin cannot join a team. Someone who reads all lists can join only when the team has a default user role.
teams.rolesNote: A team role gets its lists from the team tag automatically. Change its name, lists and deletion on the Teams screen.
teams.memberFixed: A list made by a team member always belongs to their team.
teams.requiredHelp: Choose a team to make the list. For a list only administrators see, choose "No team" on purpose.
teams.changeWarn: Changing the team changes who sees this list: members of {name} lose it, and members of the chosen team get it.
teams.fieldHelp: Members of this team see and use the list.
teams.drawMember: The new list belongs to your team.
teams.drawRequired: The source has no team. Choose the team of the new list.
teams.drawHelp: A source without a team needs a team to be chosen. A team member's list is always their team's.
teams.otherTeams: Also used on lists of other teams
teams.otherTeamsHelp: The names of other teams' lists are not shown. Only an administrator can edit, delete or blocklist this subscriber.
teams.unblockAdminOnly: Only an administrator can take a blocklisted subscriber off the blocklist.
teams.sharedLocked: This subscriber is also on lists outside your team (subscriber ID: {ids}). Only an administrator can change the name, e-mail, attributes or status, blocklist or delete them. You can still change the subscriptions on your own lists.
teams.lockedRow: This subscriber is also on another team's list. Only an administrator can delete, blocklist or edit them.
teams.lockedRecord: Has a record on another team's list
teams.lockedRecordHelp: This subscriber has a record (such as an unsubscribe) on another team's list. Only an administrator can delete, blocklist or edit them.
teams.lockedFormTitle: Only an administrator can change this subscriber
teams.lockedForm: This subscriber is also on another team's list (or has an unsubscribe record there), so the e-mail, name, status and attributes are locked. You can still change the subscriptions on your team's lists under Lists below.
teams.lockedField: Only an administrator can change this.
teams.bulkSkip: {num} of the {total} selected are also on other teams' lists and are left out. Ask an administrator to delete or blocklist them.
teams.bulkAllLocked: All {num} selected are also on other teams' lists. Ask an administrator to delete or blocklist them.
teams.bulkAllDone: Done. People who are also on other teams' lists were left out.
teams.importOverwriteLocked: A team member's import does not change the name and attributes of subscribers who already exist (they may be on other teams' lists). Only new people get what the file says.
teams.multiTeams: This list belongs to several teams ({names}) and keeps them until you choose one team.
teams.bulkAllWarn: Of these, people who are also on other teams' lists are left out. Only people on your team's lists alone are changed, and the number left out is written to the audit log.
audit.title: Activity log
audit.help: Who did what: lists, subscribers, imports, campaigns, roles and settings. Subscriber e-mail addresses are never recorded. Entries are kept for {months} months and cannot be edited.
audit.filter.query: Search by list, campaign, role or user name
audit.detail.skipped_shared: Left out (also on other teams' lists)
audit.detail.name: Name
lists.trash.title: Trash
lists.trash.help: Deleted lists stay here for {days} days and can be restored with their subscriptions, campaign links and permissions. People deleted in the meantime are not brought back. After {days} days a list is deleted for good.
lists.trash.busy: A campaign that is running, paused or scheduled sends to this list: "{name}". Finish or cancel it first.
lists.trash.exists: A list with this ID exists already.
lists.delete.title: Delete the list '{name}'?
lists.delete.trashNote: The list leaves Lists now and stays in the trash for {days} days. You can restore it from there with its subscriptions, campaign links and permissions.
lists.delete.typeName: Type the list name '{name}' to confirm
lists.delete.typeCount: Type the number of lists ({num}) to confirm
lists.delete.doneMany: Moved {num} lists to the trash ({days} days)
lists.delete.otherTeamMany: {num} of these lists belong to other teams: {teams}.
